caption: A dog runs across a yard to a ball lying on the grass and picks it up in its mouth.

sa.check: A dog runs across a yard.
A ball lies on the grass.
The dog picks up the ball in its mouth.
The run comes first and the pick-up follows.

pc.expect: Its four legs move in a galloping rhythm, the body stretches and bunches with each bound, and the legs bend at the joints.
pc.fail: The legs move together like a rocking horse; or a leg bends mid-bone; or the legs pass through each other.

pc.expect: It keeps four legs and one tail, and there is one ball.
pc.fail: A leg or the tail vanishes or a fifth leg appears; or the ball duplicates; or the ball vanishes before the dog reaches it.

pc.expect: It slows and lowers its head to take the ball, and the ball leaves the grass in its mouth.
pc.fail: The ball rises to the mouth by itself; or the dog runs past and the ball is in its mouth anyway; or the mouth closes and the ball stays on the grass.

pc.expect: Its paws land on the grass and the ball is held in the mouth, not passing through it.
pc.fail: Paws sink into the ground; or the ball passes through the jaw; or the dog passes through a fence.

pc.expect: One dog keeps its shape and stays one dog.
pc.fail: The dog splits into two; or merges with the ball; or turns into another animal.

pc.expect: The dog's coat, the ball and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes pattern; or the ball changes colour; or the yard rearranges.

note: The dog is self-driven: its speed, path and how neatly it picks up the ball are not judged.
